operator_notes_2026_08_09: 2026-08-09 fix: recipe only ever had a bare download step with url_pattern *.pdf, but this site's weekly bulletins are published as Wix-hosted .docx files (e.g. 'Bulletin 7th June 2026.docx'), never PDFs — so the download step always failed with 'did not find a matching document URL'. Added a click step to pick the newest-dated .docx link, and switched url_pattern to *.docx.

As of 2026-08-09 the newest bulletin actually published on the site is '7th of June 2026' (9 weeks stale) — the parish itself has not posted anything more recent under /weekly-bulletins. This is a genuine site-side staleness issue, not a recipe bug; harvester.bulletin_freshness should now correctly flag this as stale/actionable instead of a hard failure. There is also a 'Bulletins: 2022-Present' legacy-bulletins page linked from this page, not checked further.
